newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-POLAND NAME SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER AGAINST MOLDOVA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POLAND NAME SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER AGAINST MOLDOVA.

text.p: Coach Antoni Piechniczek on Monday named a 21-man squad for Poland's World Cup qualifier against Moldova in the southern city of Katowice on November 10.
Goalkeepers: Grzegorz Szamotulski (Legia Warszawa), Arkadiusz Onyszko (Lech Poznan).

Defenders: Pawel Wojtala (Widzew Lodz), Jacek Zielinski (Legia Warszawa), Adam Ledwon, Kazimierz Wegrzyn (GKS Katowice), Tomasz Hajto (Gornik Zabrze), Pawel Skrzypek (Rakow Czestochowa), Marek Jozwiak (Guingamp), Tomasz Waldoch (VFL Bochum).
Midfielders: Radoslaw Michalski (Widzew Lodz), Ryszard Staniek (Legia Warszawa), Piotr Nowak (1860 Munich), Jerzy Brzeczek (FC Tirol Innsbruck), Robert Wilk (Sokol Tychy).
Forwards: Marek Citko (Widzew Lodz), Cezary Kucharksi, Marcin Mieciel (Legia Warszawa), Marek Saganowski (Feyenoord), Krzysztof Warzycha (Panathinaikos Athens), Henryk Baluszynski (VFL Bochum).
